verses.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

segments.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

verses.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

segments.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

verses.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

segments.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

segments.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

verses.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

segments.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

verses.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

segments.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

verses.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

segments.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

verses.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

segments.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

verses.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

segments.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

verses.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

segments.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

verses.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

segments.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

verses.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

segments.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

verses.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

segments.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

verses.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

segments.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

verses.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

segments.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

verses.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

segments.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

verses.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

segments.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

verses.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

segments.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

verses.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

segments.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

verses.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

segments.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

verses.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

segments.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

verses.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

segments.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
